description: This file contains extension methods for IContentManager related to content item handling, including loading, validation, and retrieval with JSON path support.

classes.name: ContentManagerExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for IContentManager to facilitate content item operations.

methods.name: PopulateAspectAsync
methods.description: Populates a specific aspect of content asynchronously.

methods.name: HasPublishedVersionAsync
methods.description: Checks if a content item has a published version.

methods.name: GetContentItemMetadataAsync
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a content item.

methods.name: LoadAsync (IAsyncEnumerable)
methods.description: Asynchronously loads content items from an async stream.

methods.name: UpdateValidateAndCreateAsync
methods.description: Validates, updates, and creates a content item; marked obsolete.

methods.name: GetAsync (with jsonPath)
methods.description: Retrieves a content item or contained item via JSON path.
